extracted.intended_audience: researchers seeking ERC funding (various career stages) and those advising them
extracted.subtask_description: Help applicants identify which ERC funding scheme best matches their career stage, project ambition, team composition, prior ERC affiliation, or nationality/relocation status. Covers eligibility snapshots and targeted opportunities (starting, consolidator, advanced, proof-of-concept, synergy, special schemes).

rubrics_metrics.name: ERC Starting Grant – career-stage eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: For promising early-career researchers with 2 to 7 years experience after PhD
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Targeted at early-career researchers; applicants should check detailed eligibility (years since PhD, mobility rules) on the scheme page. (Page label: 'Explore')

rubrics_metrics.name: ERC Consolidator Grant – career-stage eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: For excellent researchers with 7 to 12 years experience after PhD
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Intended for researchers consolidating an independent research programme; applicants should verify exact eligibility windows and assessment details on the scheme page. (Page label: 'Explore')

rubrics_metrics.name: ERC Advanced Grant – track-record requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: For established research leaders with a recognised track record of research achievements
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Meant for senior investigators with an excellent track record; consult the scheme page for specifics on what constitutes a 'recognised track record' and application expectations. (Page label: 'Explore')

rubrics_metrics.name: ERC Proof of Concept – eligibility limited to ERC grant holders
rubrics_metrics.description: For ERC grant holders to explore the innovation potential of their ERC frontier research project
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only available to existing ERC grantees to translate frontier research toward innovation/uptake; details about scope and allowable activities are on the scheme page. (Page label: 'Explore')

rubrics_metrics.name: ERC Synergy Grant – team composition and ambition
rubrics_metrics.description: For 2-4 researchers combining skills and resources to tackle ambitious research challenges.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Designed for small teams of principal investigators whose combined expertise addresses high‑risk/high‑gain challenges; check scheme page for rules on number of PIs, complementarities, and consortium-level requirements. (Page label: 'Explore')

rubrics_metrics.name: ERC Plus Grant – transformative vision criterion
rubrics_metrics.description: For outstanding researchers with a vision for transformative research beyond existing ERC programmes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Aimed at researchers proposing transformative research directions that extend beyond current ERC programmes; scheme page contains further eligibility and evaluation guidance. (Page label: 'Explore')

rubrics_metrics.name: Extra funding for non-European researchers (mobility support)
rubrics_metrics.description: Extra funding for non-European researchers moving to the EU or associated countries
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides targeted additional support for researchers relocating to Europe; applicants should consult details to determine eligibility and application procedures. (Page label: 'Explore')

rubrics_metrics.name: ERC Panel member database – reviewer transparency / search
rubrics_metrics.description: Search the database to find panel members involved in ERC grant evaluations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Resource to identify experts who serve on ERC evaluation panels; useful for understanding panel composition and expertise areas. (Page label: 'Explore')

rubrics_metrics.name: Independent observers – evaluation oversight participation
rubrics_metrics.description: ERC seeks independent experts to observe and assess its grant evaluation procedures
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Opportunity for qualified experts to participate in oversight of evaluation processes; page indicates ERC recruits independent observers (details on eligibility and role on linked page). (Page label: 'Learn more')

rubrics_metrics.name: Additional opportunities – career and support options
rubrics_metrics.description: Jobs in ERC teams, visiting research fellowships, international agreements, ERC mentoring initiative
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lists supplementary opportunities related to ERC (employment, fellowships, mentoring); not direct grant schemes but relevant for career development and engagement with ERC. (Page label: 'Explore')

rubrics_metrics.name: Science Journalism Initiative – short-term stays for journalists
rubrics_metrics.description: Funding scheme to facilitate 3-5-month stays of journalists at research institutions
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Targeted opportunity to bring science journalism expertise into research institutions; eligibility, application and duration details available on the initiative page. (Page label: 'Explore')

rubrics_metrics.name: ERC for Ukraine – targeted support/jobs
rubrics_metrics.description: Jobs for researchers fleeing the war
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Special programme offering assistance and job opportunities to researchers affected by the war in Ukraine; consult the ERC for Ukraine page for application and support details. (Page label: 'Check jobs')
